integrity: The proof is analytic for arbitrary dimensions and margins. It computes the exact projected coordinate-normal norm in the row/column-sum affine hull, reduces the inradius to a max-min entry problem, and solves that problem by an exact residual-margin construction. Finite checker output is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers standard complete-support transportation polytopes with strictly positive margins and the intrinsic Frobenius metric. Sparse support graphs and other norms are outside the claim. The literature search cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased older special case.
title: Exact intrinsic Euclidean inradius and centers of transportation polytopes
